cB.role: baseline: the combined producer (lift_scan x Feistel, claude/n83-combined), unfolded index

cF.role: candidate: the same producer on the folded index

cFI.role: secondary (next improvement): cF with lift_scan canonicalizing the index build

cFaa.role: A/A control: a second process of cF

cX.role: planted positive control: cF plus the work the fold removes, redone and discarded (every mate's S3 solve and two canonicalizations in the build; every skipped state rescanned online into fold_audit_probes)

kB.role: rank stage as B runs it (unfolded, full scan, left-major), then one target

kN.role: rank stage on the folded index with lift_scan and the Feistel order, then one target

rT.role: A's tuned rho rT770 (Fold/64/DP6), the strongest one-target rho at n=83, same points

controls_pass_rule.aa: cF / cFaa ratio of mean cold totals inside [0.97, 1.03]
controls_pass_rule.planted: cX / cF ratio of mean cold totals, 95% bootstrap lower bound above 1

current_baseline: the combined producer (claude/n83-combined @ 88e1929fb, lift_scan x Feistel; its run 38803625711 had no result when this froze). If that run does not promote the combination, the better single arm is the baseline: cBL/cFL and cBF/cFF answer it.

decision_rule.improvement: R lower bound > 1 (the fold becomes the new n=83 cold baseline)

design.process_model: one point per process, fresh process per run, one pinned CPU, one runner
design.time_guard: skip a segment (rows skipped_time_guard) if elapsed + its estimate exceeds 325 min

gates: every scheduled row valid (exit 0, verified, schedule match, no memory event)
every IC process: logical state count 29,880,000; stored 14,940,300 iff folded; root table entries, logical-state blake3 and table-map digests equal B's (online.index_digest)
per point: one scalar across every IC arm and rT, replayed as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
per point: one relation (point indices) across cB, cF, cFaa, cX, cBF, cFF, cFI (Feistel order), and one across cBL, cFL (left-major)
per point: probes cB = cBF; probes cF = cFaa = cX = cFF = cFI <= cB; probes cX + fold_audit_probes(cX) = cB; probes cFL <= cBL
rank arms: full rank and the written factor-log table equal to B's archived table, log for log
multiplicity: one primary statistic; every secondary is descriptive and never changes the verdict

online.cold_interval: producer's own clock: process start (main) .. recovery_check_end of the one target = setup_complete + the five online phases (cold_in_process_ms); the rank stage is skipped (verified cached table) and measured separately by kB/kN; the index digest runs after the target, outside every interval
online.cold_targets_file: inputs/cold_targets.json (role statefold-cold-v1; disjoint from Q0, panel B, scanorder-heldout and combined-primary-v1)

index_digest.source: B's unfolded index (cB configuration), local smoke on the cloud-agent VM; deterministic

question: Does folding the duplicate ordered states (l, r, rel) ~ (r, l, -rel) of the n=83 K600 S3 root index lower the cold cost (setup + one-target online) of the combined one-target IC, with the same relation, scalar and table, on new targets?

statistics.primary: R = mean cold(cB) / mean cold(cF) over the cold points, bootstrap over points (10,000 resamples, seed 20261015)
secondary: setup, online, index-build and peak-RSS ratios cB/cF (ratio of means; online also geometric means)
single arms: cBL/cFL and cBF/cFF cold ratios; better unfolded single arm / cF
rank stage: kB/kN total ms per block and the per-attempt mean cost ratio (bootstrap over attempts)
rho ms/step from rT; cold S (setup + online) and ledger cold S (rank + setup + online) for old and new, with deltas; cold and online gaps to rT

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline'
